title: NBA: Celtics beat Sixers as Tatum outshines Brown
summary: The Boston Celtics beat Philadelphia, 123-101, to replace the 76ers at the top of the NBA Eastern Conference as Jayson Tatum outshone his former teammate Jaylen Brown in a much-hyped showdown Tuesday.
